emphasis.created: Define the event — fill in the details and pick a topic.
emphasis.topic: Confirm the topic, assign a moderator, and start the speaker pool.
emphasis.speakers: Fill the speaker pool; review submissions and start slotting as speakers confirm.
emphasis.slots: Assign speakers to time slots and finish reviews, then publish the agenda.
emphasis.finalize: Agenda is live — collect outstanding presentations, watch registrations, and send the final newsletter and catering request by their due dates. Day-of controls are available for rehearsal.
emphasis.live: Run the event — present the deck or open Live Control.
emphasis.wrapup: Send "slides are online", upload photos, and curate thank-you notes.
